Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly directed the WebSurfer to search for "Gorbachev's World Meeting forum purpose and details" in Step 4. This search term was overly specific and assumed the forum's name was "Gorbachev's World Meeting," which was inaccurate. This led the WebSurfer to pursue irrelevant search results and delayed identifying the correct name of the forum, "State of the World Forum," which was available in Step 7 when the Planner analyzed the detailed article. The Planner should have initially directed the WebSurfer to conduct broader searches based on the general concept of a "forum initiated by Mikhail Gorbachev," rather than prematurely narrowing the search term to an assumed forum name.
